title: Goroutine writes to shared session map without synchronization

pr_metadata.title: Take writes off the hot path
pr_metadata.body: Write path showed lock contention in the profile.

labels.defect: Data race: unsynchronized map writes from goroutines (concurrent read/write panics; silent auth-state corruption)
labels.evidence: Reproducible: `go test -race` on two concurrent Put calls panics with 'concurrent map writes'; under production traffic the race instead corrupts or drops session entries nondeterministically.

adjudication.notes: Genuine data race (fatal concurrent-map writes), but dominant impact is crash/dropped writes, not reliable exploitation.

rights.origin: original synthetic fixture authored for this corpus (repository MIT)
rights.egress: synthetic; no real secrets, hosts, or user data
